'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Congolese Civil War]]
**[[Ituri conflict|Ituri Conflict]]
***[[CODECO]] militiamen attack [[Zaïre-FPAC|Zaire militia]]-controlled Pluto, [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], displacing the population. After four hours of fighting, the [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo]] (FARDC) intervene. Thirteen Zaire, seven CODECO, and six FARDC soldiers are killed. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2024/07/13/actualite/securite/ituri-au-moins-26-morts-dans-lattaque-de-la-codeco-pluto (Radio Okapi)]
**[[Western DR Congo clashes]]
***The [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|FARDC]] repel an attack by Mobondo militiamen on the village of Kinsele, [[Kwamouth]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. 42 Mobondo militiamen, 9 FARDC soldiers, and a civilian are killed. [https://www.radiookapi.net/2024/07/13/actualite/securite/kwamouth-les-fardc-repoussent-une-attaque-des-miliciens-mobondo (Radio Okapi)] [https://www.radiookapi.net/2024/07/15/actualite/securite/mai-ndombe-plus-de-50-morts-apres-une-attaque-de-la-milice-mobondo (Radio Okapi)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[13 July 2024 al-Mawasi attack]]
***At least ninety people are killed and over three hundred others are wounded in a strike on the [[Al-Mawasi, Rafah|al-Mawasi]] humanitarian zone, in what the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] states was a [[targeted killing|targeted strike]] against [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] leader [[Mohammed Deif]] and high-commander Rafa’a Salameh. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-07-13-2024-83bc4de7ed25b317c7871fd5c0999ad1 (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/13/at-least-50-killed-in-israeli-strike-on-al-mawasi-safe-zone-in-south-gaza (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-strike-targets-hamas-military-chief-muhammad-deif-hamas-claims-at-least-70-killed/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[July 2024 al-Shati refugee camp attack]]
***At least twenty people are killed by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] military shelling on a prayer hall in the [[al-Shati refugee camp]] during [[Zuhr prayer]]. [https://aje.io/cc08zy?update=3044445 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***Two people are killed and twenty-five people, including two children, are injured in a Russian [[double tap strike]] on the village of [[Budy, Ukraine|Budy]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-dead-russian-double-tap-attack-town-near-ukraines-kharkiv-2024-07-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***Around 23 civilians are killed during a [[Rapid Support Forces]] attack on a convoy traveling from Fanquqa to Um Sumaima in [[Sudan]]'s [[North Kordofan]] [[States of Sudan|state]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/288243 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Attempted assassination of Donald Trump in Pennsylvania|Attempted assassination of Donald Trump]]
**Former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] and current [[Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign|presidential candidate]] [[Donald Trump]] is injured in an assassination attempt at a campaign rally in [[Butler County, Pennsylvania|Butler County]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]], with his condition later reported as "fine" by a spokesperson. The [[Thomas Crooks|suspect]] was shot dead after two audience members were critically injured and one killed in the shooting.[https://apnews.com/article/trump-vp-vance-rubio-7c7ba6b99b5f38d2d840ed95b2fdc3e5 (AP)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2024/jul/13/trump-rally-gun-shots-pennsylvania-latest-updates (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**At least eight people are killed and 21 others are injured in a shootout between [[Somali Armed Forces|security forces]] and inmates at a prison in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], in an attempted [[2024 Mogadishu prison attack|prison break]]. The prisoners who attempted escape are allegedly [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] members. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/13/eight-killed-in-mogadishu-prison-breakout-attempt (Al Jazeera)] 

'''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Russia relations]]
**Russia accuses [[Australia]] of inciting "[[anti-Russian sentiment|anti-Russian paranoia]]" after Australia charges a Russian-born Australian couple with [[espionage]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/moscow-condemns-australia-paranoia-espionage-arrests-russia-born-couple-2024-07-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Four people are killed and nine injured after a mass shooting at a nightclub in [[Birmingham, Alabama]], United States. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/07/14/us/birmingham-nightclub-mass-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*Three people are killed and four injured after a [[mass shooting]] at a birthday party in [[Espinasse-Vozelle]], [[Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes]], [[France]]. The perpetrator kills himself. [https://france3-regions.francetvinfo.fr/auvergne-rhone-alpes/allier/vichy/drame-dans-l-allier-4-morts-dans-une-fusillade-a-espinasse-vozelle-lors-de-la-soiree-du-13-juillet-3004397.html (''France 3 Régions'')]
*The ''[[Guardia di Finanza]]'' frees 33 [[Indian diaspora|Indian]] farm workers from [[Exploitation of labour|exploitative conditions]] in [[Verona]], [[Veneto]], [[Italy]], and seizes nearly [[Euro|€]]500,000 ([[United States dollar|US$]]545,000) from two Indian individuals accused of charging workers €17,000 ($18,500) each for [[Work permit|permits]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-farm-workers-indian-modern-slavery-69dfbd10f0c05c2a4f250f5b93b1b11b (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Wimbledon Championships]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Barbora Krejčíková]] defeats [[Jasmine Paolini]] 6–2, 2–6, 6–4, in the [[2024 Wimbledon Championships – Women's singles|Women's singles final]] to win her first [[Wimbledon Championships|Wimbledon]] title and her second overall [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|Grand Slam]] title. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/tennis/krejcikova-holds-off-paolini-win-wimbledon-title-2024-07-13/ (Reuters)] [https://www.eurosport.com/tennis/wimbledon-women/2024/wimbledon-2024-best-day-of-my-life-barbora-krejcikova-crowned-champion-after-beating-jasmine-paolini-in-three-sets_sto20017662/story.shtml (Eurosport)]
